主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced its intention to issue C$500 million in medium-term notes. The announcement was made in a Form 6-K filing with the SEC on January 23, 2014. The filing also incorporated by reference previous information from November 8, 2013. The filing was signed by B. D. Lawson, who holds the title of Managing Partner & CFO. This move reflects the company's strategy to raise capital through debt instruments, which is a common practice in the financial services industry.
